overall_notes: The paper focuses exclusively on extractive text summarization evaluation. It introduces a new faithfulness evaluation metric (EXTEVAL) specifically designed for extractive summarization. The human evaluation was conducted by expert annotators (including two authors and two CS undergraduate researchers) rather than crowd workers. The paper makes significant contributions to understanding and evaluating faithfulness issues in extractive summarization.
